title: Python Basics
content: Python is a high-level programming language designed for readability and developer productivity. It uses indentation for block structure and supports dynamic typing, making it a favorite for beginners and experts alike.

title: Machine Learning Overview
content: Machine learning enables computers to learn from data and improve performance over time. The field includes supervised, unsupervised, and reinforcement learning techniques.

title: Natural Language Processing
content: Natural language processing (NLP) focuses on teaching machines to understand and generate human language, including tasks like sentiment analysis, translation, and question answering.

title: Data Science Fundamentals
content: Data science combines statistics, programming, and domain knowledge to extract insights from data. It often includes data cleaning, visualization, modeling, and evaluation.

title: Deep Learning Concepts
content: Deep learning is a subset of machine learning that uses neural networks with many layers to learn high-level representations from large amounts of data.

title: Embeddings and Semantic Search
content: Embeddings are numeric vector representations that capture the meaning of text. They enable semantic search by comparing the distance between vectors instead of exact keyword matches.

title: Vector Databases
content: Vector databases store and retrieve items by their vector embeddings. This allows semantic similarity search and supports applications like recommendation and question answering.

title: Retrieval Augmented Generation
content: RAG combines retrieval from an external knowledge source with a generative model to produce more accurate and contextually grounded responses.

title: Fine-tuning Models
content: Fine-tuning adapts a pre-trained model to a specific task or domain by continuing training on domain-specific examples, improving performance on targeted use cases.

title: Prompt Engineering
content: Prompt engineering involves designing the input prompts and instructions for generative AI models to produce better outputs for a given task.
